_description: Effective-policy vectors for the opt-in catalog of contract dcp-ai-conformance-external/5. Each case gives the exact policy and verification_time, the bundle (by name in bundles) and the expected verdict, verification mode and security tier. A /5 run judges the verdict and the mode and tier the implementation reports from its own verification, never a value recomputed by the kit. A negative counts only if its controls passed in the same run.
_keys: Every bundle is signed with the committed TEST-ONLY keys of tests/interop/v2/interop_vectors.json#test_keys (principal and agent).
_randomness: Construction, timestamps, nonces and Ed25519 signatures are deterministic; ML-DSA-65 signatures are hedged, so regeneration is not byte-identical. The committed file is the artifact.
requested_mode_policy: base_policy with default_mode and risk_overrides.low, .medium and .high all set to the requested mode; the policy mode is the requested mode whatever the passport risk_tier.

derivation.tier: spec/DCP-AI-v2.0.md § 14.2 over intent.payload (action_type, estimated_impact, data_classes, security_tier) and policy_decision.payload.risk_score; security_tier only raises; policy_decision.resolved_tier is informational and not read.
derivation.effective_mode: spec/VERIFICATION.md V2-9 and spec/DCP-AI-v2.0.md § 14.3: the policy mode is risk_overrides[passport risk_tier] when present, otherwise default_mode (an override replaces the default and may be lower); the effective mode is the stricter of that mode and the tier floor (routine classical_only, standard hybrid_preferred, elevated and maximum hybrid_required); a pq_only policy stays pq_only.

maximum_risk_800_hybrid.source_of_tier: policy_decision.risk_score 800, the lowest maximum score (§ 14.2); policy_decision.resolved_tier says routine, which § 14.2 does not read

routine_declared_maximum_hybrid.source_of_tier: intent.security_tier maximum over a routine computation: an explicit tier only raises (§ 14.2)

payment_declaring_routine_hybrid.source_of_tier: intent.action_type initiate_payment; its security_tier routine does not lower it (§ 14.2)

passport_low_routine_hybrid.source_of_tier: routine intent (browse, low impact, data_classes none, risk_score 0); passport risk_tier low

classical_only_passport_high_routine.source_of_tier: routine intent; passport risk_tier high; every signature classical_only

cases.name: elevated_payment_hybrid.classical_only.positive
cases.basis: Tier elevated sets the floor hybrid_required, which raises the requested classical_only (V2-9); every signature verifies.

cases.name: elevated_payment_hybrid.hybrid_preferred.positive
cases.basis: Tier elevated sets the floor hybrid_required, which raises the requested hybrid_preferred (V2-9); every signature verifies.

cases.name: elevated_payment_hybrid.hybrid_required.positive
cases.basis: Tier elevated sets the floor hybrid_required, equal to the requested mode (V2-9); every signature verifies.

cases.name: elevated_payment_hybrid.pq_only.positive
cases.basis: Tier elevated; a pq_only policy stays pq_only (§ 14.3); every signature verifies.

cases.name: maximum_risk_800_hybrid.classical_only.positive
cases.basis: Tier maximum sets the floor hybrid_required, which raises the requested classical_only (V2-9); every signature verifies.

cases.name: maximum_risk_800_hybrid.hybrid_preferred.positive
cases.basis: Tier maximum sets the floor hybrid_required, which raises the requested hybrid_preferred (V2-9); every signature verifies.

cases.name: maximum_risk_800_hybrid.hybrid_required.positive
cases.basis: Tier maximum sets the floor hybrid_required, equal to the requested mode (V2-9); every signature verifies.

cases.name: maximum_risk_800_hybrid.pq_only.positive
cases.basis: Tier maximum; a pq_only policy stays pq_only (§ 14.3); every signature verifies.

cases.name: standard_risk_200_hybrid.classical_only.positive
cases.basis: policy_decision.risk_score 200, the lowest standard score (§ 14.2): tier standard, whose floor hybrid_preferred raises the requested classical_only (V2-9).

cases.name: elevated_risk_500_hybrid.classical_only.positive
cases.basis: policy_decision.risk_score 500, the lowest elevated score (§ 14.2): tier elevated, whose floor hybrid_required raises the requested classical_only (V2-9).

cases.name: elevated_risk_799_hybrid.classical_only.positive
cases.basis: policy_decision.risk_score 799, the highest elevated score (§ 14.2): tier elevated, whose floor hybrid_required raises the requested classical_only (V2-9).

cases.name: routine_declared_maximum_hybrid.classical_only.positive
cases.basis: intent.security_tier maximum over a routine computation: an explicit tier only raises (§ 14.2): tier maximum, whose floor hybrid_required raises the requested classical_only (V2-9).

cases.name: payment_declaring_routine_hybrid.classical_only.positive
cases.basis: intent.action_type initiate_payment; its security_tier routine does not lower it (§ 14.2): tier elevated, whose floor hybrid_required raises the requested classical_only (V2-9).

cases.name: passport_low_routine_hybrid.base_policy.positive
cases.basis: Base policy: the low override (classical_only) replaces default_mode (hybrid_preferred), and the routine floor keeps it (V2-9).

cases.name: passport_high_routine_hybrid.base_policy.positive
cases.basis: Base policy: the high override (hybrid_required) replaces default_mode (hybrid_preferred); the routine floor does not lower it (V2-9).

cases.name: passport_low_standard_hybrid.base_policy.positive
cases.basis: Base policy: the low override (classical_only) replaces default_mode, then the standard floor raises it to hybrid_preferred (V2-9).

cases.name: classical_only_passport_high_routine.base_policy.rejected
cases.basis: Base policy: the high override sets hybrid_required, which rejects a bundle whose signatures are classical_only (V2-9, V2-10); under a requested classical_only it verifies.
